title: MoE forward on one GPU
scope: One Qwen3-235B-A22B-shaped MoE forward · BF16 · sequence 4096

verification.label: Measured TorchTitan single-H100 MoE forward
verification.implementation: TorchTitan v0.2.0 Qwen3 MoE with real softmax top-k routing and torch._grouped_mm SwiGLU
verification.workload: Hidden 4096, 128 experts, top-8, expert intermediate 1536, batch 1, sequence 4096, BF16 synthetic activations
verification.measurement: 7.105 ms CUDA-event wall time; exact 6.783 ms rank-0 GPU kernel window shown
verification.timeline: Exact first-to-last rank-0 kernel window, partitioned at the first kernel of each semantic NVTX range.

description: This forward-only challenge isolates the sparse feed-forward path: produce router logits, select top-8 experts, reorder token copies into expert-major order, run grouped SwiGLU, then weight and scatter-add expert outputs back into token order.
There is no dispatch or combine collective on one GPU. In this task, permute and unpermute mean local index generation, gather, weighting, and scatter—not network communication.
The grouped-expert block includes TorchTitan's alignment padding plus three grouped GEMMs and the SwiGLU activation.

blocks.label: Router GEMM
blocks.description: Project each 4096-wide token activation to 128 expert logits. Width is the measured envelope until the first softmax/top-k kernel.

blocks.label: Softmax + top-k
blocks.description: Normalize router logits, select eight experts per token, normalize selected weights, and count assignments.

blocks.label: Permute tokens by expert
blocks.description: Stable-sort routing assignments and gather token copies into expert-major order.

blocks.label: Grouped expert SwiGLU
blocks.description: Align expert token groups, run grouped gate/up GEMMs, SiLU × up, and the grouped down GEMM.

blocks.label: Unpermute + weighted combine
blocks.description: Multiply each expert output by its routing weight and scatter-add the top-8 contributions back to original token order.
